children: Katapult, through wholly owned subsidiary CCF OpCo, entered into a Sixth Amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement to extend the draw period termination date from August 30, 2026 to September 30, 2026. The amendment maintains existing terms with lenders and Huntington National Bank as administrative agent. When the draw period ends, a 12-month amortization will begin, with maturity occurring at its conclusion absent a default. The change provides additional near-term borrowing flexibility.
: Huntington National Bank and other lenders
: Draw period through Sep 30 2026; 12-month amortization thereafter
: Extend borrowing availability under existing facility
